title: What Sales Teams Build With AI App Builders
summary: Sales teams are replacing Salesforce sprawl with custom AI tools. Here are 6 specific apps teams build with Blink — no developers needed.
body_markdown: Absolutely. The best Blink sales tools are the ones built for a specific workflow, not generic ones. A channel partner portal, an expansion opportunity tracker, a QBR prep tool — describe the exact use case and Blink generates the app. Start at[blink.new](https://blink.new/) and build this afternoon.
